verdict.rationale: Portal das Finanças is a public web portal, so publishing a robots.txt is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no probe or documentation showing a robots.txt exists. The only probe checks llms.txt (HTTP 404), which is a different artifact and cannot be credited to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
